question: Can a motor neuron's presynaptic cell-type input fingerprint identify its annotated motor population in another leg, blind to that leg's labels?
feasibility_inspection_before_registrati: Data format only: bodymap muscle entries carry 'T<segment> <side>' leg labels; vnc_intrinsic presynaptic types are MANC-style serial names (e.g. IN19A###) shared across segments; 185 vnc_intrinsic neurons are untyped.
No motor-neuron fingerprint, similarity, assignment or accuracy was computed before this file was committed.

data.loader: malecns_backend.cache.load_cache (verifies cache source fingerprints against the tracked canonical files)

labels.source: bodymap.json muscles entries whose name matches '^(.+) T([123]) (left|right)$'
labels.joint_classes: set of actuator prefixes (actuator with the trailing '_T<segment>_<side>' removed) over all entries of that population and leg
labels.ambiguous_neuron: a dense index listed under two different base populations or two legs; excluded from reference and scoring and counted

fingerprint.input: all incoming synapses (CSR rows are presynaptic); weight = synapse count, no threshold
fingerprint.feature: presynaptic neuron type string; presynaptic neurons with an empty type are excluded
fingerprint.normalization: L1 to input fractions; neurons with zero typed input are excluded and counted
fingerprint.reference_centroid: mean of member fingerprints per reference-leg population
fingerprint.assignment: argmax cosine similarity to reference centroids; ties broken by sorted population name

tasks.serial_primary: 12 ordered (reference leg, target leg) pairs with the same side and different segment
tasks.contralateral_descriptive: 6 ordered pairs with the same segment and opposite side
tasks.scorable_target: unambiguous labeled target neuron whose population also exists in the reference leg
tasks.type_correct: assigned population equals the target neuron's population
tasks.joint_correct: assigned population's joint classes intersect the target neuron's joint classes

null.method: within each reference leg, permute population labels across reference neurons (pool sizes preserved), rebuild centroids, recompute pooled serial type accuracy

acceptance.FAIL: data integrity holds and any of a-d is false
acceptance.INCONCLUSIVE: source/cache verification fails, or fewer than 10 scorable serial targets for any admitted class

interpretation_limits: Ground truth is the MaleCNS motor-neuron annotation, not muscle tracing; annotators may themselves have used connectivity, so a PASS can partly reflect annotation method.
A PASS only licenses using this method as a hypothesis generator for unlabeled middle/hind Tarsus1 candidates under a separate protocol; it admits no coordinate and assigns no sign, gain or mapping.
Front 'tarsus' (Tarsus1) pools exist only in T1 and cannot be scored serially here; that is the gap a later protocol would address.
Offline connectome analysis only; no physics, CNS simulation or Unity.
single_run: Executed once after this protocol, the code and its tests are committed; no retries, thresholds or features changed after seeing results.
